cases.name: invented-scoped-react-package-and-prefixed-exports
cases.source: import { SniceApp, SniceRouter, SniceRoute, SniceButton, SniceTabs, SniceTab, SniceDialog } from '@snice/react';

cases.name: valid-react-wrappers-can-use-central-registration
cases.source:
import { Button, Input, Table } from 'snice/react';
export const View = () => <Button><Input /><Table /></Button>;

cases.name: react-router-contract
cases.source:
import { Route, SniceRouter } from 'snice/react';
const app = <SniceRouter><Route path="/" element={<Dashboard />} /></SniceRouter>;

cases.name: react-form-event-contract
cases.source:
import { Input, Select } from 'snice/react';
const form = <><Input onChange={(event) => save(event.target.value)} /><Select onChange={(event) => save(event.target.value)} /></>;

cases.name: invented-table-tabs-modal-and-toast-props
cases.source:
import { Modal, Table, Tabs, Toast } from 'snice/react';
const view = <><Tabs value="queue" /><Modal title="Edit" onClose={close} /><Toast open={true} onClose={close} /><Table rows={people} /></>;

cases.name: invented-badge-and-navigation-models
cases.source:
import { Badge, Nav } from 'snice/react';
const view = <><Badge tone="warning">Warn</Badge><Nav items={[{ label: 'Home' }]} /></>;

cases.name: terra-static-table-column-keys
cases.source:
import { Badge, Table } from 'snice/react';
const view = <Table columns={[{ key: 'id', header: 'ID' }, { key: 'status', header: 'Status', render: (row) => <Badge>{row.status}</Badge> }]} />;

cases.name: terra-secondary-button-variant
cases.source:
import { Button } from 'snice/react';
const view = <Button variant="secondary">Refresh</Button>;
